verdict.rationale: Kit's API/MCP lets an agent create a broadcast targeted at a segment and either draft or schedule it (kit-docs-1, kit-docs-2, kit-docs-5, kit-docs-20), and drafts inherently sit unsent until a human acts. However, there is no explicit documented 'approval queue' or review-before-send workflow distinct from a generic draft/schedule state. Missing for 10: an explicit human-approval gate or review step separate from the plain draft/schedule state, and independent confirmation the MCP agent flow actually respects this human-in-the-loop pattern.
